subject: RFP: Commercial terms — usage safety net & invoice-offset proposal
messages:
From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novamedica.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamedica.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: Model inference pricing & commercial terms (extraction attached)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this RFP. Attached is the commercial portion of our vendor questionnaire and a brief extract of our expected monthly profile. Key areas we need detail on: commit tiers and associated list prices, overage rates and smoothing/true-up cadence, buffer/burst protections (we'd like a plan that avoids invoice surprises), and any invoice credit/offset mechanics you offer. Please also include guidance on embeddings vs. generation pricing, and any seasonal/burst protections you can provide for a three-month launch ramp.

We plan to share your commercial response with our procurement and finance teams next week. If you can return a short commercial sheet plus a brief narrative explaining how smoothing / invoice offsets work operationally, that would be ideal.

Attached: NovaMedica-RFP-extract.pdf

Best,
Amanda Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
NovaMedica

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@novamedica.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: Model inference pricing & commercial terms (extraction attached)

Amanda,

Appreciate the context and the extract — thanks. Attached is a concise commercial offer and an explanatory note. High level summary of the recommended structure (we designed this to limit invoice volatility while keeping unit economics transparent):

1) Commitment tiers (monthly committed tokens; price per 1K tokens for generation):
   - Tier A: 100M tokens/mo at $0.95 per 1K tokens
   - Tier B: 500M tokens/mo at $0.68 per 1K tokens
   - Tier C: 1B tokens/mo at $0.52 per 1K tokens

2) Overage and smoothing:
   - Grace band: Up to 10% monthly overage consumes a pre-funded Invoice Offset Pool (IOP) at $0.00 incremental charge until pool exhausted; the pool is sized as 10% of monthly commit by default.
   - Standard overage charge beyond IOP: 120% of committed unit price (e.g., Tier B overage = $0.816 per 1K tokens).
   - True-up cadence: Quarterly true-up (settle variance vs commit each quarter); unused IOP is not refundable but rolls into next quarter's buffer once per year (annual rollover cap = 5% of annual committed volume).

3) Burst credits and launch ramp:
   - One-time Launch Burst Credit equal to 25% of month 1 committed tokens for first 3 months (applied automatically to invoices during ramp).

4) Embeddings: flat $0.11 per 1K tokens for embedding generation (no commit discounts applied to embeddings unless a specific embeddings-only commit is agreed).

5) Discounts & incentives:
   - First-year introductory discount of 12% on list price for signed 12-mo commitment (applies to the unit price used to calculate overage).
   - Additional volume incentive: if annual consumption >= 9x monthly commit, apply an extra 5% rebate at year-end.

6) Contract mechanics and billing flow:
   - Monthly invoices with line-item commit, actual consumption, IOP draw, and overage calculation.
   - Quarterly true-up invoice/credit adjustments.
   - Invoice Offset Pool funded by prepayment or as a retained credit (customer choice).

I've attached the spreadsheet with worked examples for three profile scenarios from your extract. If you want a softened overage profile we can increase the IOP or reduce the overage multiplier in exchange for a higher monthly commit or longer term.

Attachments: RI-commercial-offer-v2.xlsx, terms-summary-20261218.docx

Next steps: If this aligns with your team's tolerance, we'd like to propose a short call (30m) to walk procurement and finance through the invoice flow and an example invoice. I can host next Wed or Thu morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to feedback.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Ben — quick internal thread.

We reviewed the draft commercial structure. Two asks before we send final to NovaMedica: 1) Karthik asked for a first-year 12% intro discount — can we stretch to 15% for NM given it's a strategic healthcare account and their 3-month ramp profile? 2) confirm margin sensitivity if we increase the IOP to 15% of commit (to reduce sticker overage risk).

Ben: can you run a P&L scenario for 500M commit (Tier B) with both (a) 12% discount + 10% IOP and (b) 15% discount + 15% IOP. Include impact on gross margin and the expected payoff window assuming a 6-month ramp. I need this by EOD so we can finalize language for procurement.

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Amanda — thanks for the prompt review. We incorporated internal feedback and are proposing the revised commercial terms below (attached updated spreadsheet has the worked invoice examples):

Revised offer (reflects a 15% first-year introductory discount and a 15% Invoice Offset Pool for launch):

- Proposed monthly commit (example): 500M tokens/mo (Tier B)
  - List price (Tier B): $0.68 per 1K tokens
  - First-year intro price after 15% discount: $0.578 per 1K tokens

- Invoice Offset Pool (IOP): 15% of monthly commit funded as a retained credit (customer may elect prepayment). For 500M commit, IOP = 75M tokens equivalent (applied at 0 incremental charge until exhausted).

- Overage beyond IOP: 115% of committed unit price (post-discount) — in this configuration overage = $0.6647 per 1K tokens.

- Launch Burst Credit: additional one-time credit equal to 25% of month 1 commit applied across first 3 months to absorb ramp spikes.

- True-up cadence: Quarterly true-up with rolling carry-forward of unused IOP credits once annually (cap = 5% of yearly committed volume).

- Embeddings: $0.10 per 1K tokens (embeddings excluded from generation commit unless explicitly included).

- Rebate: If annual consumption >= 9x monthly commit we will issue a 5% end-of-year rebate on invoiced consumption.

Operational notes:
- The IOP is visible on each invoice as a retained credit line. Quarterly trueups produce a single adjustment invoice/credit with clear line items.
- If NovaMedica prefers a lower invoice complexity we can offer a combined monthly fixed invoice (commit + amortized IOP charge) with a single reconciliation at quarter end. That option requires a 12-mo minimum and increases the commit floor by 7%.

Attachments: RI-commercial-offer-v2.xlsx (worked examples), terms-summary-20261218.docx

If that aligns, I propose a brief 30-minute overview call with your procurement/finance next Tue 10am EST. If you'd like a version with pre-funded IOP (we'd show OPEX vs CAPEX treatment), we can produce that in the same spreadsheet.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
